delivery.outcome: Distinguish unreadable and invalid governance manifests from absent governance adoption using bounded read-only evidence
nonGoals: Do not change permissions in observed repositories
Do not mutate an observed repository
Do not infer repair authority from observation errors
Do not read secrets or stash state

architecture.decision: Record manifest observation status in the repository projection and route unreadable or invalid carriers to Doctor with stable error codes
interfaceChanges: local repository declarations include governanceCarrier status
architecture.rollback: Revert the governanceCarrier projection, diagnoses and regression tests

commands: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
